conditions.evidence: risk for and resilience to age-related cognitive impairment
conditions.label: age-related cognitive impairment

modalities.evidence: no contraindications for blood draw or MRI

output.population: Adults aged 50–79 identifying as White, Black, or Hispanic, with no diagnosis of memory loss or dementia and no history of psychotic illness
output.summary: Multi-site in-person study of brain aging at four US universities, enrolling adults aged 50–79 with MRI, aimed at understanding risk for and resilience to age-related cognitive impairment.
